title: Mobility Equipment Intake Standards — Qualification Documents and Delivery Values by Class
content:
# Intake Standards Schedule — Mobility Equipment

This schedule gives, for each Mobility Equipment class, the qualification documents an order must carry and the values that govern its delivery.

## Value definitions

- **Face-to-face lookback** — calendar days before the order date within which the face-to-face mobility examination must have taken place; 0 when not required.
- **Specialty evaluation** — whether a PT/OT or physiatrist specialty seating evaluation is required.
- **ATP involvement** — whether a RESNA-certified Assistive Technology Professional must take part in the selection.
- **Home accessibility assessment** — whether an in-home accessibility assessment showing the home accessible is required before delivery.
- **Power-mobility prior authorization** — whether the class falls under the coverage's power-mobility prior-authorization requirement.
- **Written order validity** — calendar months a written order stays usable to deliver the chair.
- **Delivery lead** — business days from a complete order (and any affirmed authorization) to delivery.
- **In-home delivery with training** — whether delivery must be in the home with user training.

## Schedule

| Class | Face-to-face lookback (days) | Specialty evaluation | ATP involvement | Home accessibility assessment | Power-mobility prior authorization | Written order validity (months) | Delivery lead (business days) | In-home delivery with training |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 0 | no | no | no | no | 12 | 2 | no |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 0 | no | no | no | no | 12 | 3 | no |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 0 | no | no | no | no | 12 | 3 | no |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 0 | yes | yes | no | no | 6 | 10 | yes |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 180 | no | no | yes | yes | 6 | 10 | yes |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 180 | yes | yes | yes | yes | 6 | 20 | yes |

## Points of reading

- A lookback of 0 means the class does not require a face-to-face examination; only K0823 and K0856 carry a lookback, of 180 days.
- K0005 is the only manual class requiring both a specialty evaluation and ATP involvement, and the only manual class delivered in the home with training.
- The two power classes are the only classes requiring a home accessibility assessment and the only classes falling under the power-mobility prior-authorization requirement.
- **Hypothetical comparison.** Two written orders, each nine months old: one for a K0004 chair is still within its 12-month validity; one for a K0823 chair is past its 6-month validity.
